lines.text: In Lagos, an importer sends a thirty percent deposit to a supplier in Shenzhen.
The seventy percent balance is where it goes wrong.
Goods that never arrive: this week, a man in Bauchi was charged over ₦5.7 million paid for a tractor that never came.
Over three billion dollars lost in 2025 to fake "bank details changed" messages. And the naira still moves in weeks.
Arra is Latin for earnest money: the deposit that secures a deal.
Pay the deposit, and keep the balance locked in an open contract on Celo.
Before any order, paste the page you found them on. Arra's agent reads it, and searches X and Reddit for complaints.
This example shop has two customer complaints: high risk.
A real seller comes back green. The agent pays for this data itself: half a cent a lookup, over x402, through the buy marketplace on Celo.
And suppliers can confirm their own page, so impersonators get flagged.
Describe the order like a message, and the assistant fills in the terms.
Vague words like "good quality" are refused, and the terms are fingerprinted, so they can't change later.
Send your supplier one link. They read the terms in English or Chinese, and agree from their own wallet.
You see their record and reviews, and a changed payout address sets off an alarm.
Pay from the wallet you already use: MiniPay, MetaMask, Rabby, or any wallet on Celo. In dollars, or straight from naira.
Lock the order. The supplier accepts, and the deposit reaches them instantly. The balance waits.
Every naira payment is a Textile FX fill: one firm quote for exactly the dollars needed, settled in one transaction.
That one rate matters. This October, a seven-thousand-dollar balance cost a quarter of a million naira more, in just twenty days.
With Arra, it's paid for on day one.
When they ship, the container number is checked, and your check period starts when the goods arrive.
All good? Pay the balance in one tap, or in parts.
Something wrong? Report it with signed photos, and make an offer.
Cancel before they accept. No accept, or no shipment, and Arra's agent refunds you automatically.
A quiet buyer can't hold the money: ignored offers go through in seven days. And nobody, not even Arra, can redirect it.
Afterwards, both sides review each other, hidden until both have written. Receipts and history stay with every order.
It works for any deposit-and-balance deal: a house built back home, furniture made to order, a freelance project.
Live on Celo mainnet: a friend's real order ran start to finish.
Verified contract, a registered agent, naira filled through Textile, and supplier checks paid over x402.
Arra. Trade with anyone, without the worry.
